actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatInviteServices.set#RoomListed').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId || '', listed: String(listed) === 'true' ? 'Y' : 'N'}).call() || {} ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {reasonCode: out.reasonCode || null} : {listed: !!out.listed})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatInviteServices.find#JoinRequests').parameter('chatRoomId', chatRoomId || '').call() || {} ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {reasonCode: out.reasonCode || null} : {requestList: out.requestList || []})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.chat.ChatInviteServices.find#ListedRooms').parameter('searchText', searchText || null).call() || {} ec.web.sendJsonResponse({roomList: out.roomList || []})
